_doc: HUMAN-OWNED FILE. Nothing in this pipeline writes here.
When the source API renames a field, drift.py detects it by value-set overlap
and writes a SUSPECTED_RENAME into output/drift/drift_report.md. It does NOT
act on its own conclusion, because a wrong auto-mapping would silently corrupt
every downstream classification. A human reads the report and adds the mapping
here. normalize.py reads only this file.
Until a mapping is confirmed here, normalize.py emits null for the target field
and lists the unmapped source field in the record's _unmapped_fields array.
The gap is visible; it is never silently filled in.
This is the same machine-proposes / human-approves boundary that Phase 2
requires for agent learning, applied one layer earlier to schema meaning.

clause_type.note: Original field name from the v2.1 contract API.

category.note: Confirmed after reviewing drift_report.md for run clauses_batch_2__*. Value-set overlap with clause_type was 0.75; a human verified the six shared category values before approving this mapping.
